note: Astra starter round 4 per-stage concepts. Two archetypes per element (a/b). Every stage has its own pose/body-plan brief. 3-4 colour core palette + one accent legible at 64px.

stages.name: 잎꼬미
stages.design: A baby leaf-lemur starter sitting on all fours in a compact round ball shape: a very big round head (half of its height) with a big plain cream face, a round leaf-green body, two big round leaf-shaped ears, short stubby legs.
stages.signature: one long thick tail with three broad cream rings curled into a single big round spiral beside its body, as big as its head
stages.accent: soft pink (only one small closed flower bud on its forehead)
stages.palette: leaf green, cream, dark forest green, soft pink

stages.name: 잎원숭
stages.design: The evolved form: a sturdy young leaf-lemur standing UPRIGHT on two legs in a lively balancing pose, one arm raised, a plump solid body (not skinny), a big round head with a big cream face, larger pointed leaf ears, the forehead bud half open.
stages.signature: the long ringed tail rising high above its head and curling into a big spiral like a question mark, taller than its body
stages.accent: soft pink (only the half-open forehead flower)
stages.palette: leaf green, cream, dark forest green, soft pink

stages.name: 잎현자
stages.design: The final form: a tall serene leaf-lemur sage FLOATING cross-legged in the air in a meditation pose with its arms folded, a broad solid body clearly bigger than before, a short cape of four or five big broad leaves over its shoulders, a calm friendly face with big eyes, the forehead flower fully open with one round pink gem at its centre like a third eye.
stages.signature: the huge ringed tail forming one big closed circle behind its whole body like a halo ring
stages.accent: bright pink-violet (only the forehead flower and its gem)
stages.palette: leaf green, cream, dark forest green, pink-violet

stages.name: 잎너구
stages.design: A baby tanuki (raccoon dog) pup starter sitting on all fours, round and chubby: a very big round head with a cream face and a dark brown eye mask around big bright eyes, small round ears, a round moss-green and brown body, a short fat striped tail.
stages.signature: one big broad bright-green leaf balanced on top of its head like a hat, as wide as its head
stages.accent: bright lime green (only the big head leaf)
stages.palette: moss green, warm brown, cream, dark brown

stages.name: 잎둔갑
stages.design: The evolved form: a chubby young tanuki standing UPRIGHT on two legs with a round belly, holding a big leaf in one paw like a fan, a cream face with the dark eye mask and big eyes, a big fluffy striped tail behind it.
stages.signature: the head leaf grown into a wide flat leaf straw-hat shape on its head
stages.accent: bright lime green (only the leaf hat and the leaf fan)
stages.palette: moss green, warm brown, cream, dark brown

stages.name: 잎선인
stages.design: The final form: a big wise tanuki sage FLOATING cross-legged above one huge round leaf, a big round belly and a broad body clearly bigger than before, a cream face with the dark eye mask and kind big eyes, a long white beard tuft, a huge fluffy striped tail curling around it.
stages.signature: a tall crown of three big upright leaves on its head with one glowing pink-violet orb floating between them
stages.accent: pink-violet (only the floating orb) and lime green leaves
stages.palette: moss green, warm brown, cream, dark brown

stages.name: 불양이
stages.design: A baby lamb starter standing on four short stubby legs: a very big round head with a warm red-orange face and big bright eyes, a big round puffy cloud of cream wool covering its head top and body, small floppy ears, tiny dark hooves, a small puff tail.
stages.signature: two tiny curled horn nubs on its head that glow ember yellow-orange
stages.accent: bright yellow-orange (only the two little horn nubs)
stages.palette: red-orange, cream wool, dark maroon, yellow-orange

stages.name: 불박치
stages.design: The evolved form: a sturdy young ram standing UPRIGHT on two legs in a boxing guard with both fists raised, a red-orange body, a thick round cream wool collar around its neck and wool wraps on its fists, a confident grin, big eyes.
stages.signature: two medium curled horns, each tip ending in one small crisp flat flame
stages.accent: bright yellow-orange (only the two horn-tip flames)
stages.palette: red-orange, cream wool, dark maroon, yellow-orange

stages.name: 불뿔왕
stages.design: The final form: a huge heavy ram champion with a massive broad chest covered by a big cream wool mane, LEANING FORWARD low in a charging headbutt stance on two thick legs, thick muscular arms with big dark hoof fists, a brave friendly face with big eyes.
stages.signature: two huge thick spiral horns curling around the sides of its head, each horn wrapped in one big crisp flat flame
stages.palette: red-orange, cream wool, dark maroon, yellow-orange

stages.name: 불캥이
stages.design: A baby kangaroo joey starter SITTING upright in a round compact shape on big feet, a very big round head with a cream face and big bright eyes, SHORT small round ears (not rabbit ears), a warm orange-red body with a cream belly, tiny paws held up in front.
stages.signature: a short thick tail tipped with one round crisp flame like a torch

stages.name: 불권투
stages.design: The evolved form: a chunky young kangaroo boxer HOPPING forward on big feet, leaning in, short round ears, cream bandage wraps on both fists, a big cream belly, a confident grin, big eyes.
stages.signature: a long thick tail held out straight behind it with a bigger round flame on the tip

stages.name: 불챔프
stages.design: The final form: a huge heavy champion kangaroo standing tall and wide, a massive broad cream chest and belly, short round ears, a brave face with big eyes, propped on its thick tail like a third leg.
stages.signature: two huge round fists that are solid balls of crisp flat flame, each as big as its head, raised in a victory pose
stages.accent: bright yellow-orange (only the two flame fists and the tail tip)

stages.name: 물범고
stages.design: A baby orca calf starter lying on its belly on four tiny stubby flipper feet, one round bean-shaped head-and-body, a navy-blue back and a pure white belly and chin, a happy open smile, a short tail fluke.
stages.signature: each big round shining eye sits INSIDE a large white oval patch on the side of its head, so the white patch frames the eye like a big round spectacle
stages.accent: pale cyan (only a small rounded dorsal fin)
stages.palette: navy blue, white, dark navy, pale cyan

stages.name: 물파도
stages.design: The evolved form: a sleek young orca SLIDING forward on its belly with its head raised high and its chest lifted on two broad front flippers, a longer body, a navy back and white belly, the eye inside the big white eye patch, a confident smile.
stages.signature: a tall curved dorsal fin shaped like a breaking wave, pale cyan with a white crest
stages.accent: pale cyan (only the wave dorsal fin)
stages.palette: navy blue, white, dark navy, pale cyan

stages.name: 얼음고래
stages.design: The final form: a huge heavy orca beast standing on FOUR thick flipper legs like a guardian lion, a massive long body, a broad white chest, the eye inside the big white eye patch, a heavy tail fluke, a calm protective face.
stages.signature: the dorsal fin grown into one tall smooth pale-cyan iceberg crest with three big clean facets
stages.accent: pale cyan ice (only the iceberg crest)
stages.palette: navy blue, white, dark navy, pale cyan

stages.name: 물바다코
stages.design: A baby walrus pup starter lying round and plump on its belly, a very big round head with big bright eyes, a big round puffy white muzzle with two tiny rounded tusks, a smooth sky-blue body with a pale belly, two small front flippers.
stages.signature: one small water-spout fountain splashing up from the top of its head like a little geyser

stages.name: 물분수
stages.design: The evolved form: a chunky young walrus SITTING UP proudly on its tail with its chest out, two long tusks, a white whisker muzzle, broad front flippers on its hips, big eyes, a confident smile.
stages.signature: a tall water-spout column on its head ending in a round splash like a crown

stages.name: 얼음분수
stages.design: The final form: a huge heavy walrus lying low and wide like a great boulder, propped on two big front flippers, a massive body clearly bigger than before, a white beard muzzle, big calm eyes.
stages.signature: the head spout frozen into one tall smooth pale-cyan ice fountain crown, and two very long smooth ice-crystal tusks reaching the ground
stages.accent: pale cyan ice (only the ice crown and tusks)
stages.palette: sky blue, white, navy, pale cyan
